description: Independent prerequisite for ensure/folder consumers. Functional specs/files: extend canonical Channels DataSourceBridge and Events/Api with authorized source record context, provider/config/record canonical identity, current permissions and bounded nearest-first ancestry. Disk delegates through Storage API to EntryCatalog ancestry; remote providers traverse immediate parent IDs through existing authorized get_file. No label tables or ingestion writes. Tests before implementation: extend data_source_bridge/entry catalog boundary suites for success, nil/denied/update actor, cross-provider/config spoofing, cycles/depth limits, multiple-parent ambiguity and inaccessible ancestor redaction, no unexpected side effects; existing assertions remain unchanged. Mocking: external provider edge only, real internal Events/permissions. Docs: owning Channels/Storage module docs and service guide contract. Reuse: get_file/list_permissions, EntryCatalog.ancestors_many and existing dispatch; do not build second hierarchy. Input canonical ref + trusted actor; output trusted record+permissions+ordered ancestor refs or typed denied/notfound/incomplete/ambiguous error. No public agent tool. This prerequisite can run alongside typed persistence because it touches independent service ownership; parent ensure integration remains blocked on both. Tests/mix q only; no precommit/push. Read AGENTS and tool/workflow/action/test/conventions/domain policies.
